analysis:
Units 37 and 38 are CHANGELOG.md head lines 2633-3156. They contain historical v0.10.0 release notes and earlier entries. They are documentation only, outside the changed range (head 11-39), and unchanged by this PR. The text was examined for claims bearing on T-041 (prefix cache scope and SSD tier), TB-007, TB-013 and TB-014. The lines are pre-existing, so this pass identifies no regression from them.

The actual PR change is head lines 11-39, visible only in the file_changes patch excerpt, which is truncated. It adds the 0.10.10 candidate and the `darkbloom waitlist` command. Under it, a new sandbox setup (`darkbloom sandbox setup`, TB-013/T-061) and new two-Mac pairing (TB-014-adjacent cluster flows) require account approval from the coordinator. `darkbloom cluster local` stays offline and needs no approval, and existing installs are never asked.

The excerpt ends at "If the coordinator does not offer waitlists yet, both new setups go on as in 0." That suggests fail-open behavior when the waitlist endpoint is absent. Integration should confirm that this gate is only a product or rollout control, not a security control.

Integration must also check four points against the source that implements these flows:
- Approval responses are authenticated with the provider token (A-008).
- The approval response cannot alter the installer URL or command, or the root GPU-limit invocation (T-061, T-062).
- `--yes` auto-joining does not bypass the owner confirmation for running the installer.
- The new coordinator call leaks no token in logs.

No source for these flows was supplied here, so this is a coverage limit, not a clearance.
